text: D3a-15 opened. Re-oriented (J's drift ruling): handback-C5.md was read at D3a-14 in this conversation; elements and arrows hash as at D3a-06 (4b4e277f, e0ba1b0b); history 139 lines, no change since. validate.py --open D3: only the standing EXPECTATIONS.jsonl error. No question open. Next group: P09 alone, as one element with many lines (886). T4-020 also holds C02 (715 lines, 540 absent), but C02 sits under four fourth-order themes and its companions are K03 and K04 (ties and quarrels from before the canvas), so it is taken with them later. F-007 (A16 and A17 orders from the attack call) concerns P09's arrows; mem.py findings --touching P09 returns none

Group opened: P09 (T4-020, Repertoire of contention; attacks on others' work), 886 lines in 703 rooms, all unruled; counts from d3_group_close.py: instantiate 558, absent 169 (146 unobserved, 22 not-testable, 1 observed-absent), restrict 77, add-condition 35, link 25, add-step 22; the labelers' kinds are specification 727, elaboration 82, correction 77. Repaired rooms hold 479 lines, unrepaired 407. P09's statement: 'Rooms attack others' work by the recurring moves the canvas affords: erasing, encroaching, converting a sign, raiding on a streamer's call, planting a script, altering a work as a joke'; range from one member's call to deface a rival to a coordinated raid. Not stated as universal (T4-020 counts 231 of 705 rooms), so absent lines are never corrections. Arrows: A15 into it; A16, A17, A18 out of it. G20 written into notes-D3.md before any line was ruled: P09 is the room's own repertoire (A15 to A18 order the room's own call or act), so an attack the room suffers, or a visitor's attack call or claim, is not the room's P09 unless its members join; help, terms and apologies (G17 to G19) are read from either record because both rooms act in them. Encroaching counts whatever the intent; one member's call is the lower range; contests in talk and brigading off the canvas are P18's; attack talk after hour 73 is an evidence limit unless aimed at a successor canvas. Draws from verb offset 226 (the sampler finds 99 instantiate lines in that packet, as before)
